instruction: Repo owner, live in this conversation, directly and explicitly instructed: build the Android app, install on the connected Master Device if present, then merge feature/jukebox-device-resilience into master, update the changelog and version, and push to the remote. Branch implements BACKLOG.md items 30 (Jukebox device SSE connection not surviving Android backgrounding -- fixed via a new native AppPinning Capacitor plugin + status/enable UI, and the frontend actually subscribing to the jukebox-device-status SSE event it already received but ignored) and 31 (Master Device showing a confusing self-referential offline message -- fixed by having PlaybackControls use useIsJukeboxDevice() and control volume directly via the existing native VolumeControl plugin instead of round-tripping through the backend). Includes a commit (ddc6aed) bumping config.yaml 1.0.28 -> 1.0.29 with a matching CHANGELOG.md entry.
notes: Preflight before this record: backend `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; frontend `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; backend `npx vitest run` 417/417 passing; frontend `npm run build` clean; frontend `npm run lint` shows only the pre-existing warning baseline. `git diff --stat master...feature/jukebox-device-resilience` confirmed touching only the planned files, no backend changes.
